observations: Two photos of a used automatic transmission casing.
The casing is dusty and shows signs of heavy use.
A label is visible on the top surface of the casing in photo 0, but the text is illegible.
The casing features a central housing with a large black plastic electrical connector and a smaller white connector on the right side.
A metal bracket is attached to the left side of the casing.
The item is resting on a dark, rough surface, likely asphalt or concrete.

claims.claim: Dealer in all kinds of Japanese
Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The casing may be a used part from a different vehicle or a used unit from a different brand.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's identification plate (usually on the side or back).
risks.if_unproven: as a generic used transmission casing

risks.risk: Internal mechanical damage or internal leaks may exist.
risks.proof: A video showing the transmission being shifted through all gears while the engine is running.

risks.risk: The electrical connectors may be damaged or loose.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter test of the electrical connectors.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate on the side or back of the casing.
Video of the transmission being shifted through all gears while the engine is running.
Photo of the electrical connectors with a multimeter test.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
